name: station
description: STATION — professional operating system for bartenders. V1 scope: Auth, Home, Tools, Vault. TypeScript, strict mode.

scripts.web: npm run build && node -e "require('./dist/src/http/static-server').createStaticServer().listen(process.env.WEB_PORT||4002,()=>console.log('STATION web app listening'))"

_notes.runtime: TypeScript, strict mode, compiled via tsc to dist/. Runtime deps are still zero external packages - node:sqlite, node:test, node:http are Node built-ins. TypeScript itself (tsc/@types/node/undici-types) is available globally in this sandbox and vendored into node_modules/ for this project's use, not installed via npm (no network access - see README).
_notes.postgres_status: NOT executed. db/postgres-migrations/all_tables.sql is written in correct syntax but has never run against a real Postgres server, none exists in this sandbox. src/shared-kernel/data-access.postgres.reference.ts documents exactly what's needed to complete this (a real pg install, and converting the Database interface to async).

intended_production_stack.database: PostgreSQL (db/postgres-migrations has the translated schema; data-access.ts's Database interface needs to become async first - see data-access.postgres.reference.ts)
intended_production_stack.http_framework: Fastify-class framework (replaces src/http/server.ts's raw node:http routing)
intended_production_stack.test_runner: node:test is a legitimate long-term choice
